cues.text: Atop Tartarus, Ikutsuki aims a pistol at Mitsuru's father.
Chained to crosses: Akihiko, the hero, Junpei, Fuuka, Yukari and Mitsuru.
The two men fire at once.
Mitsuru's father doubles over, bleeding onto his gun.
Aigis stands alone.
Aigis's targeting sight locks onto each of them.
Her raised hand shakes as the sights sweep across them.
The hero.
Memories flash: the dorm, the beach, school.
She turns her fingertip guns away from them and fires.
The chains break. Mitsuru lands on the cracked floor.
Akihiko drops free.
Koromaru, with the remote.
From above, the freed team closes in on Ikutsuki.
The whole team stares at him, silent.
Ikutsuki doubles over. Blood drips onto the floor.
He steps to the edge.
Grinning, he tips backward off the edge.
He falls into the dark until he is gone.
The team stands in shock.
Mitsuru kneels beside her fallen father.
Tears on her face. Her eyes close.
